places.name: National Museum
places.description: India's largest museum, holding over 200,000 artifacts spanning 5,000 years of Indian art, archaeology and decorated arts. Highlights include Harappan antiquities, Mughal miniatures and a dedicated Buddhist art gallery.
places.address: Janpath Rd, New Delhi, Delhi 110011

places.name: National Rail Museum
places.description: An open-air museum near Chanakyapuri displaying vintage steam locomotives, royal saloons and rail memorabilia from the 19th and 20th centuries. A joy ride toy train circles the grounds on weekends.
places.address: Service Rd, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi, Delhi 110021

places.name: Crafts Museum
places.description: A living museum near Purana Qila showcasing traditional Indian crafts, textiles and folk art, with resident artisans demonstrating pottery, weaving and woodwork in an open courtyard setting.
places.address: Bhairon Marg, Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: National Gallery of Modern Art
places.description: Housed in the former residence of the Maharaja of Jaipur near India Gate, this gallery holds one of the finest collections of modern and contemporary Indian art, including works by Raja Ravi Varma and Amrita Sher-Gil.
places.address: Jaipur House, India Gate, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

places.name: India Gate
places.description: A 42-metre war memorial arch honouring soldiers of the Indian Army, set at the eastern end of Rajpath. The surrounding lawns are a popular spot for evening walks, ice cream vendors and picnics.
places.address: Rajpath, India Gate, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and the first garden-tomb on the Indian subcontinent, built in 1570 for Mughal Emperor Humayun. Its Persian charbagh gardens and red sandstone dome inspired the Taj Mahal.
places.address: Mathura Rd, Nizamuddin, New Delhi, Delhi 110013

places.name: Qutub Minar
places.description: A 73-metre UNESCO World Heritage minaret begun in 1193, the tallest brick minaret in the world. The surrounding archaeological complex includes the Iron Pillar and the ruins of the Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque.
places.address: Seth Sarai, Mehrauli, New Delhi, Delhi 110030

places.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
places.description: The 17th-century Mughal fortress of red sandstone that served as the main residence of the Mughal emperors for nearly 200 years, now a UNESCO World Heritage Site hosting the annual Independence Day flag hoisting.
places.address: Netaji Subhash Marg, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi, Delhi 110006

places.name: Lotus Temple
places.description: A Bahá'í House of Worship shaped like a blooming lotus flower, completed in 1986. The white marble-clad structure is open to people of all faiths for silent meditation and prayer.
places.address: Lotus Temple Rd, Bahapur, New Delhi, Delhi 110019

places.name: Akshardham Temple
places.description: A vast Hindu temple complex on the banks of the Yamuna, combining traditional Indian architecture with modern exhibitions, a musical fountain and boat ride depicting Indian history and culture.
places.address: Noida Mor, Pandav Nagar, New Delhi, Delhi 110092

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.description: One of the largest mosques in India, commissioned by Shah Jahan and completed in 1656. Its vast red sandstone and marble courtyard can hold 25,000 worshippers, with a minaret climb offering panoramic Old Delhi views.
places.address: Jama Masjid Rd, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi, Delhi 110006

places.name: The Imperial New Delhi
places.description: A heritage luxury hotel on Janpath dating to 1931, blending Victorian, Art Deco and colonial architecture. Renowned for its extensive collection of 19th-century art and its Spice Route restaurant.
places.address: Janpath Ln, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: The Leela Palace New Delhi
places.description: A five-star palace-style hotel in the Diplomatic Enclave inspired by Lutyens' Delhi architecture, featuring a rooftop pool, spa and multiple award-winning restaurants overlooking the Chanakyapuri skyline.
places.address: Diplomatic Enclave, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi, Delhi 110023

places.name: The Lalit New Delhi
places.description: A centrally located five-star hotel near Connaught Place with contemporary interiors, a rooftop pool and Baluchi, one of the city's longest-running fine-dining Indian restaurants.
places.address: Barakhamba Ave, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Indian Accent
places.description: A globally acclaimed fine-dining restaurant at The Lodhi hotel, reimagining classic Indian dishes through a modern culinary lens. Regularly ranked among Asia's 50 Best Restaurants.
places.address: The Lodhi, Lodhi Rd, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

places.name: Bukhara, ITC Maurya
places.description: An iconic North-West Frontier restaurant famous for its dal bukhara and tandoori kebabs, served in a rustic log-cabin setting. Has hosted heads of state including US presidents.
places.address: ITC Maurya, Sardar Patel Marg, New Delhi, Delhi 110021

places.name: Karim's, Jama Masjid
places.description: A legendary Mughlai eatery operating near Jama Masjid since 1913, said to trace its lineage to the royal kitchens of the Mughal court. Known for slow-cooked mutton korma and seekh kebabs.
places.address: 16, Gali Kababian, Jama Masjid, New Delhi, Delhi 110006

places.name: Saravana Bhavan, Connaught Place
places.description: A long-running South Indian vegetarian chain outlet in Connaught Place, popular for dosas, idlis and filter coffee served in a bright, no-frills dining room.
places.address: P-15, Connaught Circus, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Lodhi Garden
places.description: A landscaped park spread across 90 acres containing 15th-century Sayyid and Lodhi-era tombs. A favourite spot for morning joggers, birdwatchers and picnicking families.
places.address: Lodhi Rd, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

places.name: Nehru Park
places.description: A sprawling green space in Chanakyapuri with an open-air amphitheatre that hosts weekend concerts and yoga sessions, plus wide lawns favoured for morning walks and cricket.
places.address: Africa Ave, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi, Delhi 110021

places.name: Deer Park, Hauz Khas
places.description: A forested park adjoining Hauz Khas Village with a small fenced deer enclosure, a lake and the ruins of a 14th-century madrasa, popular for evening strolls near the village's cafes.
places.address: Hauz Khas, New Delhi, Delhi 110016

places.name: Garden of Five Senses
places.description: A themed sensory garden near Saket with sculpture trails, a food court, terraced lawns and a stepped amphitheatre, designed around the five human senses.
places.address: Saidul Ajaib, Mehrauli, New Delhi, Delhi 110030

places.name: Connaught Place
places.description: Delhi's colonial-era commercial hub, a colonnaded circular market ringed with international and domestic retail brands, bookstores, cafes and the underground Palika Bazaar.
places.address: Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Dilli Haat, INA
places.description: An open-air crafts bazaar and food plaza operated by Delhi Tourism, hosting rotating stalls of artisans from across India selling textiles, handicrafts and regional street food.
places.address: Sri Aurobindo Marg, INA, New Delhi, Delhi 110023

places.name: Khan Market
places.description: An upscale market known for independent bookstores, designer boutiques and some of the city's best cafes, consistently ranked among the world's most expensive retail streets.
places.address: Khan Market, New Delhi, Delhi 110003

places.name: Purana Qila (Old Fort)
places.description: A 16th-century fort on the banks of the Yamuna believed to stand on the site of Indraprastha, offering quiet ramparts, a boating lake and evening light-and-sound shows.
places.address: Mathura Rd, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Agrasen ki Baoli
places.description: A striking 14th-century stepwell near Connaught Place with 108 symmetrical stone steps descending into shadow, a favourite spot for photography and said to have inspired scenes in Bollywood films.
places.address: Hailey Rd, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

places.name: Chandni Chowk Street Food Trail
places.description: A roaming trail of legendary street-food stalls through Chandni Chowk's lanes — parathas, jalebi and chaat — with no single fixed address since the trail covers several lanes.
places.address: Chandni Chowk, Old Delhi, Delhi 110006

places.name: Central Park, Connaught Place
places.description: A sprawling circular landscaped public park in the heart of Connaught Place, featuring expansive lawns, water fountains, and amphitheatre spaces.
places.address: Inner Circle, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001
